notes.subject: security
notes.why_in_news: The BSF IG announced that the Ministry of Home Affairs is considering a proposal for a new design of barbed wire fencing along the India-Bangladesh border to replace aging infrastructure.
notes.fact_box: India shares a 4,096 km international border with Bangladesh, with Tripura accounting for 856 km of this stretch. The BSF is currently working with the Bangladesh Border Guard (BGB) on joint patrolling and cattle smuggling prevention.

prelims_pointers.text: India-Bangladesh international border length is 4,096 km.
Tripura shares 856 km of its border with Bangladesh.
Border Security Force (BSF) is the primary agency for guarding India's international borders.
Bangladesh Border Guard (BGB) is the counterpart agency on the Bangladesh side.
The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) is the nodal ministry for border management and BSF operations.

notes.mains_question: Discuss the significance of integrated border management systems in curbing transnational crimes like cattle smuggling and ensuring national security along the India-Bangladesh border.
mains_dimensions: Infrastructure degradation: Weather-induced wear and tear of existing barbed wire fencing necessitating structural upgrades.
Cooperative security: Effectiveness of joint patrolling and 'zero line' monitoring between BSF and BGB.
Transnational crime: Challenges in policing 'border haats' and managing cattle smuggling across porous boundaries.
